style.prompt: Energetic vertical promo video for a modern gym. Fast-paced cinematic shots: an athlete slams heavy battle ropes, a woman lifts a barbell with determination, close-up of chalked hands gripping a pull-up bar, sweat drops in dramatic side light, people sprinting on treadmills. Bright modern gym with dark walls, warm spotlights and neon accents, dynamic camera moves and quick cuts. Soundtrack: upbeat, driving electronic workout music with a strong beat. No voice, no speech, no narration. No on-screen text, no logos.
